description: Restructure encrypted storage with envelope encryption (AES-256-GCM) and implement Shamir Secret Sharing for key recovery. Change storage layout to data/raw, data/md, data/csv, data/images, data/vectors, uploads/. All artifacts encrypted at rest with unique DEKs wrapped by KEK.
steps: Step 1 - Add 'pycryptodome' and 'secretsharing' (or implement Shamir's scheme) to pyproject.toml. Actually use 'pycryptodome' for AES-256-GCM and implement Shamir SSS manually (it's simple polynomial interpolation over GF(256) or use the 'shamir-mnemonic' package if available, otherwise implement a minimal version).

Step 2 - Create app/services/encryption.py with: (a) EnvelopeEncryption class - generate_dek() returns 32-byte random key, encrypt_dek(dek, kek) wraps DEK with KEK using AES-256-GCM, decrypt_dek(wrapped_dek, kek) unwraps, encrypt_file(plaintext_path, output_path, kek) encrypts file with unique DEK and stores wrapped DEK in file header, decrypt_file(encrypted_path, output_path, kek) decrypts. (b) File format: [4-byte magic][4-byte version][12-byte nonce][16-byte tag][32-byte wrapped_dek_nonce][16-byte wrapped_dek_tag][32-byte wrapped_dek][...ciphertext]. (c) dek_zeroize(dek_bytes) - overwrite memory with zeros after use.

Step 3 - Create app/services/key_recovery.py with: (a) ShamirSecretSharing class - split_secret(secret: bytes, threshold: int, num_shares: int) returns list of share tuples, reconstruct_secret(shares: list) returns original secret. Implement using polynomial evaluation over GF(256). (b) KeyRecoveryManager - generate_kek() creates master KEK, split_kek(kek, threshold=2, shares=3) splits KEK into shares, recover_kek(shares) reconstructs KEK from threshold shares, export_share(share, path) saves share securely, import_share(path) loads share.

Step 4 - Create app/models/encryption.py with: EncryptionKey (id, key_type [kek|dek], key_id_hex, created_at, is_active, metadata_json), KeyShare (id, share_index, share_holder, created_at, is_distributed).

Step 5 - Refactor app/services/storage.py to use the new directory layout: data/raw/ (encrypted originals), data/md/ (encrypted markdown), data/csv/ (encrypted tables), data/images/ (encrypted images), data/vectors/ (ChromaDB - not encrypted, it handles its own storage), uploads/ (temporary, unencrypted waiting area). The StorageService should now encrypt files using EnvelopeEncryption when saving to data/ subdirs and decrypt when reading.

Step 6 - Update app/services/pipeline.py to use the new storage paths. After conversion, store markdown in data/md/, extracted images in data/images/, tables in data/csv/. Original uploaded files move from uploads/ to data/raw/ after processing.

Step 7 - Create app/api/settings_encryption.py router with: GET /settings/encryption (HTML page), GET /api/settings/encryption/status (key status), POST /api/settings/encryption/init (initialize KEK + generate shares), POST /api/settings/encryption/recover (reconstruct KEK from shares input). Protect with require_role('admin').

Step 8 - Create app/templates/settings_encryption.html template showing: encryption status, KEK status (active/needs-init), share distribution status, recovery interface (input shares to reconstruct), key rotation interface.
Step 9 - Register the new router in app/api/router.py. Add models to __init__.py.

Step 10 - Update tests: modify tests/conftest.py storage fixture to use new layout, add tests/test_encryption.py covering envelope encryption (encrypt/decrypt roundtrip), Shamir SSS (split/reconstruct with various threshold combinations), storage service encryption integration.
acceptance_criteria: EnvelopeEncryption class correctly encrypts/decrypts files with unique DEKs wrapped by KEK
AES-256-GCM is used for both DEK wrapping and file encryption
ShamirSecretSharing correctly splits and reconstructs secrets with 2-of-3 threshold
Storage layout uses data/raw, data/md, data/csv, data/images, data/vectors, uploads/
Files in data/ subdirectories are encrypted at rest
DEK is zeroized from memory after use
Key recovery page allows admin to reconstruct KEK from shares
Encryption status page shows current key state
All existing tests pass with updated storage paths
New encryption tests verify roundtrip correctness
verification: uv run ruff check app/ tests/
